map.EHS 勃起硬度评分结合 NPT 夜间阴茎勃起监测，评估勃起硬度并鉴别 ED 性: The EHS erection hardness score combined with NPT nocturnal penile tumescence monitoring to assess erection hardness and differentiate the nature of ED
map.阴茎勃起硬度 EHS 分 1 至 4 级（4 级完全坚挺）；NPT 夜间勃起监测: Erection hardness score (EHS) is graded 1 to 4 (grade 4 fully rigid); normal criteria for NPT nocturnal erection monitoring: frequency not below 3, each episode not below 10 minutes, maximum rigidity not below 70%; meeting all three suggests psychogenic ED, otherwise organic ED is suggested.
map.1级 - 阴茎增大但不硬: Grade 1 - penis enlarged but not hard
map.2级 - 硬但不足以插入: Grade 2 - hard but not enough for penetration
map.3级 - 硬可插入但未完全坚挺: Grade 3 - hard enough for penetration but not fully rigid
map.硬，但不足以插入阴道: Hard, but not enough for vaginal penetration
map.硬足以插入，但未完全坚挺: Hard enough for penetration, but not fully rigid
map.NPT 正常提示心理性 ED；NPT 异常提示器质性 ED（血管/神经/内分泌）:
Normal NPT suggests psychogenic ED; abnormal NPT suggests organic ED (vascular/neurogenic/endocrine).
NPT is the 'gold standard' for distinguishing psychogenic from organic ED and requires continuous monitoring for at least 2-3 nights.
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供临床参考，ED 病因诊断需结合病史、体检、激素、血管超声等综合评: ⚠️ This tool is for clinical reference only; the etiologic diagnosis of ED requires a comprehensive assessment combining history, physical examination, hormones and vascular ultrasound.
map.EHS 3 级（硬可插入未完全坚挺）= 轻度 ED；NPT 次数≥3、时长≥10: EHS grade 3 (hard enough for penetration but not fully rigid) equals mild ED; NPT frequency >= 3, duration >= 10 min and rigidity >= 70% is normal.
map.EHS 1 级（增大不硬）= 重度 ED，建议药物/真空/假体等综合治疗。: EHS grade 1 (enlarged but not hard) equals severe ED; combined treatment such as medication, vacuum devices or a prosthesis is recommended.
map.NPT 正常标准？: What are the NPT normal criteria?
map.夜间勃起≥3 次、单次≥10min、硬度≥70% 且根粗≥3cm 提示器质性 E: Nocturnal erections >= 3 times, each >= 10 min, rigidity >= 70% and base diameter >= 3 cm indicate a low likelihood of organic ED.
map.EHS 勃起硬度分级是什么？: What is the EHS erection hardness grade?
map.EHS 1 级：阴茎增大但不硬；2 级：有硬度但不足以插入；3 级：硬度足以插入: EHS grade 1: the penis is enlarged but not hard; grade 2: there is hardness but not enough for penetration; grade 3: hard enough for penetration but not fully rigid; grade 4: completely hard. If NPT is normal while EHS is low, psychogenic or situational factors usually predominate.
